description: SaveRequest is what the page sends to write the file.

yaml.description: YAML is the whole file to write.

layout.description: Layout is the placements to write to the sidecar when WriteLayout is set.

items.description: Placement is where one node sits on the canvas.

id.description: ID is the node's id in the pipeline.

x.description: X is the left edge, in canvas units.

y.description: Y is the top edge, in canvas units.

w.description: W is the width; zero means the page decides.

h.description: H is the height; zero means the page decides.

write_layout.description: WriteLayout says whether to write the sidecar at all. A page that has not moved a node leaves a pipeline without one alone.

version.description: Version is the Document.Version the page last saw. A save against any other version is refused and the current document is returned instead.
